title: pad trigger keeps steady spread without focus aim
why: RT used the focus aim flag to steady shots, so it also cut sprint, slowed walking and pulsed a scope. Keep the existing pad spread and settle time separately. Playtest watch: on a pad, RT no longer cuts the sprint or pulses a scoped view; LT still aims. Pad players move at full speed while shooting; check a pad fight still feels fair.
now: pad trigger fire keeps its steady spread without cutting sprint or pulsing a scoped view. lt and right mouse still aim.

edits.replacement:
// v28.xx (cw-cx-rtsteady): his 10-20 aim order names right mouse and LT; RT settles spread only.
  if(PAD.adsAim){ G.player.ads=true; PAD.adsing=1; }
PAD.rtHeld=false; PAD.ltHeld=false; PAD.adsT=0; // v28.xx (cw-cx-rtsteady): a released pad cannot leave a spread bonus behind.
if(shotSteady(p)) base*=0.4; // v28.xx (cw-cx-rtsteady): retain the movement bloom bonus on RT.
return t.cone*Math.max(0,Math.min(1,p.bloomK||0))*(shotSteady(p)?0.5:1); // v28.xx (cw-cx-rtsteady): RT retains the same bloom cone.
